build-instant-qte-h5.title: 瞬时反应 QTE H5
build-instant-qte-h5.description_en: Build and validate mobile HTML5 quick-time event (QTE) games with real player input and browser playtest evidence.

build-pseudo-live2d-character.title: 单图角色动效规划
build-pseudo-live2d-character.description_en: Plan browser character animation from a single illustration: breathing, blinking and layered motion; not a Cubism model generator.

day-night-cycle.title: 日夜视觉曲线

fps-feel.title: 射击反馈与可控性
fps-feel.description_en: Improve FPS shooting feel: recoil, spread, hit feedback and reload timing.

free-input-output.description_en: Integrate natural-language player actions with LLM result validation, timeouts, duplicate-submit protection and atomic settlement; not just chat UI.

game-skill-router.title: 游戏任务分派
game-skill-router.description_en: Select the smallest relevant game design, balancing, systems or game-feel skill set for a concrete task.

improve-arpg-hit-feel.title: 近战反馈诊断
improve-arpg-hit-feel.description_en: Diagnose melee combat responsiveness, hit impact, hit reactions and recovery timing.

inventory-system.title: 背包状态与交易
inventory-system.description_en: Design inventory capacity, item identity, atomic transactions, equipment exchange and persistence.

number-adventure-like.title: 冒险关卡节奏
number-adventure-like.description_en: Balance adventure, platformer and puzzle levels through checkpoints, resource pressure and progression.

number-card-roguelike.title: 牌组构筑数值
number-card-roguelike.description_en: Balance deckbuilding roguelikes: card draw, energy costs, deck choices and combat rewards.

number-diablo-arpg-like.title: 刷宝与装备成长
number-diablo-arpg-like.description_en: Balance loot-driven action RPG damage, survivability, equipment upgrades and drop rewards.

number-legend-like.title: 长线成长与资源经济
number-legend-like.description_en: Balance long-term RPG progression, upgrades, loot, trading and competitive power tiers.

number-orchestrator.title: 游戏数值实验流程
number-orchestrator.description_en: Turn game experience goals into numerical models, tunable parameters and balance experiments.

number-shared.title: 数值口径与计算检查
number-shared.description_en: Review units, probability, distributions, bounds and sensitivity in game balance formulas.

number-shmup-like.title: 弹幕压力与火力覆盖
number-shmup-like.description_en: Balance shoot-em-up bullet patterns, dodgeability, firepower, survivability and scoring.

number-sim-management-like.title: 生产网络与经营回报
number-sim-management-like.description_en: Balance management simulations, factories and idle games through production bottlenecks, inventory and expansion returns.

number-survivor-like.title: 局内压力与成长反馈
number-survivor-like.description_en: Balance survivor-like horde pressure, upgrade pacing and in-run builds.

number-tower-defense-like.title: 塔防波次与部署取舍
number-tower-defense-like.description_en: Balance tower defense waves, path exposure, targeting, coverage and resource budgets.

number-turn-card-like.title: 回合与阵容成长
number-turn-card-like.description_en: Balance turn-based card RPG action economy, speed order, character growth and team composition.

scene-transition.title: 转场状态与恢复
scene-transition.description_en: Implement or diagnose scene loading, input handoff, transition effects and failure recovery.

screen-shake-effects.title: 相机冲击反馈
screen-shake-effects.description_en: Design camera shake, hit-stop and impact feedback with stacking limits and reduced-motion settings.

stamina-system.title: 体力扣费与恢复
stamina-system.description_en: Design stamina costs, regeneration, caps, offline recovery and duplicate-request handling.

survival-ui-guidelines.title: 生存游戏操作界面
survival-ui-guidelines.description_en: Design and review survival game HUD, inventory, crafting and building interfaces.
